findings: Bundled vulnerable RSC missed by production-only audit: fixed and regression tested.
Terminal DNS-dot HTTP bypass: regraded material and fixed with two regressions.
finding_resolution.verification: Four regressions failed before fix;165-test suite green after fix; final compiled Worker7/7, final browser44/44 and separate guarded builds pass. No second review claimed.

rulings.decision: Prepared maintenance in an isolated branch while owner sleeps; preserve production until normal review/merge.
rulings.reason: Owner requested uninterrupted checks and necessary fixes; existing workflow reviews changes before production.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Fixes remain pending on live until a normal merge; current working release is retained.

rulings.decision: Use exact compatible transitive security overrides instead of relying on deep dependency update.
rulings.reason: Nested vulnerable versions persisted after selective pnpm update. Existing release-age/build policy remains intact.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Pins need future maintenance; frozen install, tests and both builds verified compatibility now.

rulings.decision: Treat terminal DNS-dot HTTP bypass as material and normalize the official hostname.
rulings.reason: Absolute DNS spellings can refer to the same application; redirect to its canonical HTTPS hostname.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Only that official-host alias redirects; localhost, preview and lookalikes remain unchanged.

rulings.decision: Patch the plugin vendored RSC and align React/ReactDOM/RSC19.3.1, not merely the root RSC package.
rulings.reason: Production-only audit missed executable React code vendored by the build plugin. Two installed-runtime regressions catch both app and Vinext consumers.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: React minor update can cause behavior regressions; final165 tests, builds and44 candidate browser checks pass, actual live account writes remain untested.

rulings.decision: Correct the optional local mock runner to avoid the outbound proxy for loopback only.
rulings.reason: Initial local timeout was proxy403, not an app failure. Other external backend requests remain mocked or blocked.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Remote preview still uses inherited proxy; local-only behavior is covered by17 passing scenarios.

rulings.decision: Describe HTTPS fix as protecting application pages/callbacks, not all edge/static responses or HSTS.
rulings.reason: Cloudflare can serve static assets before Worker middleware; no edge policy write tool is available.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Public static assets may remain accessible over HTTP; universal enforcement requires a Cloudflare edge setting.

rulings.decision: Do not infer real account login, lesson saving, private-file access, or email delivery from simulated backend tests.
rulings.reason: No authenticated test-account/inbox tool or password was available; user data and private files were not fetched.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Owner must still confirm those real production flows before considering functional launch acceptance complete.

rulings.decision: Retain prior installed DB evidence and unchanged SQL/contracts instead of repeating manual SQL checks.
rulings.reason: This task changes frontend dependencies/middleware only;12 November installed-state and content-preservation results are already verified.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: An unrelated external database change since that snapshot would require a fresh scoped check.

rulings.decision: Record wider toolchain advisories and pre-existing full lint debt without mass unrelated upgrades/refactoring.
rulings.reason: Full audit has0critical but62 lower-severity wider graph findings; full lint remains66errors/69warnings (released baseline72/75).
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Tooling maintenance/security review remains; no claim that the entire repository is lint/security clean.

rulings.decision: Do not claim demonstrated RSC exploitability, physical Safari/overnight behavior or production deployment of this candidate.
rulings.reason: No exploit, physical-device, elapsed-time or deployment test was performed.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: These remain unverified rather than being represented by unrelated synthetic passes.
